# Twin Space Studio

> Residential and commercial interior design studio based in Mahalunge, Baner,
> Pune, India, serving Pune and Pimpri-Chinchwad (PCMC). Full-service design,
> turnkey execution and styling, typically 10-12 weeks from concept to
> completion, quoted line by line before work begins.

## Services
- Residential interior design (apartments, villas, bungalows, duplexes)
- Commercial interior design (offices, retail, commercial spaces)
- Turnkey execution and project management
- Modular kitchens, wardrobes and storage, false ceilings and lighting
- Styling and finishing

## Indicative pricing
- 2 BHK full home interior: INR 12-16 lakh
- 3 BHK full home interior: INR 16-21 lakh
- 4 BHK and duplex: quoted on scope
- Final cost depends on scope, materials and finishes; a transparent
  line-item quote is shared before work begins, and the figure quoted on
  day one is the figure at handover.

## Process
Six stages over 10-12 weeks: Discover, Conceptualize, Design & plan,
Select & finalize, Execute, Deliver & stylize.

## Service area
Pune and Pimpri-Chinchwad (PCMC), Maharashtra, India. Areas served include
Baner, Kharadi, Wakad, Balewadi, Kothrud, Hinjawadi, Koregaon Park,
Viman Nagar, Kalyani Nagar, Aundh, Mahalunge, Bavdhan, Punawale,
Magarpatta City, Pashan, Tathawade, Hadapsar, Erandwane, Mundhwa, Sus
and Kondhwa.
